answer: A farm dies on the first hurdle when the hurdle is Endorsed pewter engraver plate file with pewter engravers standing, and the hurdle is 4-year training, 91 supervised engravings, quality exam, guild dues. The farm's budget must cover 504 proofs at 110 POA each — 55440 POA — before any reward is even possible. Count the cipher in the file, count the voyage in the wallet, and count the summit in the years: the numbers never favour the farm. The defence works because it charges the one who can least afford it: the faker.
